criteria.requirement: Expose `window.runnerDebug` as soon as the game script initializes, even when webcam permission is denied or poseNet never becomes ready.
criteria.action: Load the built browser app with getUserMedia rejected and do not allow the pose model to become ready.
criteria.expected: All five documented debug methods exist and resetCourse(193) completes without webcam or pose input. (Tolerance: Exact method presence; no uncaught reset error.)

criteria.action: Reset with seed 193, read getCourse(), and independently reproduce the specified LCG draw sequence.
criteria.expected: The first ten records have indices 0 through 9, Z values 0 through 900 in steps of 100, and exactly the independently computed signed offsets and widths. (Tolerance: Exact integers and Z coordinates.)

criteria.requirement: Reset camera position to `(0,10,-35)`, camera Y rotation to `Math.PI`, head position to `(0,10,0)`, `cameraSpeed` to `0.25`
criteria.action: Advance a course, change its state, then call resetCourse() and inspect getState().
criteria.expected: The documented transforms and scalar state are restored, manualMode is true, and the course contains ten walls. (Tolerance: Positions within 1e-9; other values exact.)

criteria.requirement: `step(count)` synchronously executes exactly `count` former gameplay iterations
criteria.action: After resetCourse(193), call step(40) and inspect camera and head transforms.
criteria.expected: Camera Z is -25 and head Z is 10; X and Y remain unchanged, and no additional advancement occurs while subsequently rendering in manual mode. (Tolerance: Absolute Z error no greater than 1e-9.)

criteria.requirement: Require an integer count from 1 through 10000; throw `RangeError` for any other value without changing state.
criteria.action: Capture state, then attempt step(0), step(1.5), and step(10001).
criteria.expected: Each call throws RangeError and the serialized state and course remain unchanged. (Tolerance: Exact error type and deep state equality.)

criteria.requirement: Do not use `Math.random()` for wall hole offsets or hole widths; unrelated wall colors may remain random.
criteria.action: Reset twice with seed 193 and once with seed 194, comparing getCourse() results after each reset.
criteria.expected: Same-seed offset and width sequences are identical, while seed 194 differs from seed 193 in at least one geometric parameter. (Tolerance: Exact sequence equality for equal seeds.)

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the initial rendered 3D scene and its declared state. Inspect task-relevant depth and geometry across at least three views where appropriate, and inspect composition, materials, lighting, color, and legibility.
Exercise the central interaction and numeric or geometry contract through the visible UI. Verify meaningful scene/state feedback without inventing unrequested controls.
Repeat the boundary, invalid-input, recovery, and reset sequence while inspecting live scene state.
Inspect 1440x900 and 390x844 layouts, including lower controls and keyboard focus. Reload and inspect console/resource diagnostics.
